title: Fail closed on invalid offer types before classification or persistence
objective: Reject every offer_type that is not an exact member of app.models.vocab.OFFER_TYPES before Z0 classification or publication persistence, while routing official evidence-backed invalid candidates to an explainable pending human review.
acceptance_criteria: A1: classify(OfferFacts(...)) returns UNKNOWN with explicit nonempty unrecognised-offer-type reasons and blocking conditions for unknown, empty, whitespace, invented, uppercase, and non-string runtime values (including equality, hashing, and string-coercion impostors) before every other classification branch or protocol operation.
A2: Exact canonical values preserve existing behavior: safe always_free and other can be Z0, trial is Z2, self_hosted_open_source is Z3, and known billing or unknown material conditions remain safe.

A3: Publication schema completeness requires offer_type to be a string and an exact member of app.models.vocab.OFFER_TYPES; no normalization, case folding, literal duplication, or string coercion is permitted.

A4: An official evidence-backed invalid candidate routes to pending human review with schema_complete in failed_conditions before _do_publish, _resolve_offer, or any Offer, OfferVersion, or Quota insert.

A5: On real PostgreSQL 16, one invalid and one valid candidate in the same source and ScanRun produce reviewed=1, published=1, publish_error=None, explicit CLI counts, a pending invalid review item, no invalid offer persistence, and a committed valid offer graph.
A6: Database CHECK constraints and migrations remain unchanged as defense in depth.
A7: Required truthiness mutation and one additional predicted mutation are each observed failing the focused tests, then restored byte-exactly.
A8: The full repository check passes; CI runs all 13 Python steps at the pushed head and reports exactly two permitted stack-health skips.
verification_plan: pytest -q with DATABASE_URL pointing at isolated PostgreSQL 16
pwsh -File scripts/stack-smoke.ps1 against the isolated stack
git diff --check and exact do-not-touch diff inspection
GitHub Actions Python job log inspection by step name and pushed head SHA
data_implications: No migration. Invalid candidates remain in candidate/evidence history and gain a pending ReviewItem; no Offer, OfferVersion, or Quota is created for that identity.
security_privacy: No network or credential behavior changes. The change reduces success-shaped partial publication and unsupported Z0 claims.
portability: Pure Python vocabulary membership checks only; no platform-specific code or new dependency.
z0_risk: High-risk A3 slice: an invalid offer type currently falls through to Z0 and can reach a database constraint. Exact canonical membership must fail closed.
